entries.text: `Lambda.subs` no longer replaces an expression that contains a bound variable. Formerly, `Lambda(x, x**2).subs(x**2, z)` incorrectly gave `Lambda(x, z)`; now it gives the unchanged `Lambda(x, x**2)`

title: Lambda.subs no longer replaces expressions that contain its bound variable
